prompt: Story in one wide scene, left to right: (1) the alpaca author proudly holding a freshly published technical book with small confetti; (2) a thin timeline line with three round icons — a pen on paper, a gear on a document, a party popper; (3) the same alpaca now worried at a laptop showing a red error symbol, scratching its head, with a scribble cloud above; (4) two reader avatars (a young man with a laptop, a woman with a phone) each with an empty speech bubble containing only a red exclamation mark, plus small icons of an envelope with alert dot, a chat bubble and a coin with a return arrow.
name: problem

prompt: Three equal panels side by side separated by white space, each a small vignette in a rounded frame: left — a reader at a desk frustrated at a laptop with a red error symbol and coins slipping away with a clock; middle — the alpaca author overwhelmed by many incoming complaint bubbles with red exclamation marks and a calendar with many pages flipping; right — a publisher standing in a warehouse next to tall stacks of unsold books and a small recycling bin.
name: stakeholders

prompt: The fix in one wide scene: on the left a technical book with a small red error mark on one page; in the center a friendly assistant drawn as a large cornflower-blue magnifying glass with a tiny spark, searching through a neat stack of official documentation pages (blank lines only), then a small test tube and a play button with a green check mark showing the example was run; on the right the alpaca author at a desk reviewing a neat envelope/document with a check mark and an approve stamp, and the same book now glowing softly with a circular refresh arrow. Dotted arrows connect the steps left to right.
name: solution

prompt: A living book ecosystem: in the center an open book softly glowing with a circular refresh arrow around it; around it three circular vignettes connected by gentle curved arrows forming a loop: a happy reader holding a tablet with a refresh symbol, the happy alpaca author uploading an update to a small cloud with an up arrow, and a happy publisher next to a small printer printing one fresh book on demand. Calm, optimistic mood.
name: vivo
